data.name: Amaryl
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Amaryllis was a beautiful nymph who fell in love with Alcioneus, a shepherd. She offered to give him her beauty if he could love her in return. He refused, and she vowed to prove her love by remaining motionless for thirty nights, surrounding herself with flowers. The gods, moved by her devotion, turned her into a beautiful flower that bore Amaryllis' name. In Christianity, Amaryl can be seen as a symbol of unwavering love and devotion.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering love and devotion.
data.numerology_meaning: Creative, imaginative, and artistic, Amaryl may find joy in expressing themselves through various mediums. They have a strong desire to be appreciated for their talents and may put great effort into perfecting their craft.

in_hebrew.name: אמריל
in_hebrew.meaning: אמריל - שמו של פרח או צמח בעברית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אמריל הוא שם שמקורו בעברית ומתייחס לשמו של פרח או צמח. אין אזכור ישיר לשם זה בתנ"ך, אך הוא עשוי להיות קשור למילה 'מר' שפירושה מריר או שמן. השם עשוי לשאת משמעות רוחנית הקשורה לטבע ולצמיחה.

in_greek.name: Αμαρύλ
in_greek.meaning: Αμαρύλ - σημαίνει το λουλούδι ή το φυτό
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Αμαρύλ στην ελληνική γλώσσα αναφέρεται σε ένα λουλούδι ή φυτό. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος δεν είναι άμεσα συνδεδεμένη με τη Βίβλο, αλλά μπορεί να έχει σχέση με την ελληνική λέξη για το 'αμαρύνω', που σημαίνει να στερεώνομαι ή να καρφώνομαι. Στην πνευματική και πολιτιστική παράδοση, το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει την ανάπτυξη και την ομορφιά.

in_latin.name: Amaryl
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Amaryl in lingua Latina origine non directe a Biblica scriptura derivatur, sed refert ad nomen floris vel plantae. data.cultural_impact: The name Amaryl harkens back to the ancient Greek myth of Amaryllis, a nymph who demonstrated an unyielding love for the shepherd Alcioneus. Although he rejected her affections, Amaryllis remained steadfast, and her devotion was eventually recognized and rewarded. This story of enduring love has resonated across generations and cultures. A name like Amaryl might evoke the idea of unwavering commitment, resilience, and the power of the human spirit to demonstrate love even in the face of disappointment or rejection.
data.spiritual_significance: Additionally, the name Amaryl carries a strong spiritual significance. It can serve as a reminder of the eternal and unconditionally loving nature of God. The devotion of Amaryllis to Alcioneus, despite his initial rejection, echoes the depth of God's love for us, which remains constant and unwavering, even in the face of our imperfections and shortcomings. Furthermore, it can also be considered a reminder of the value of patience and perseverance, emphasizing the belief that love conquers all and eventually triumphs.
